messages:
nina: Postmortem follow-up: capturing owners & quick mitigations for the streaming reliability cluster we discussed (timeouts, silent partials, reconnect storms). Aim to have concrete deliverables before the leadership sync.

omar: I'll take the reconnect storm playbook. Plan: define SDK defaults (backoff base, cap, jitter), and a server-side connection admission control window to smooth reconnects. ETA: Wed noon. Ticket RW-6101.

lucy: I'll own silent-partial detection + dashboard. Proposal: emit 'chunk-gap' events and add an alert for session_gap_rate > 0.3% over 10m. ETA: Tue AM. Ticket RW-6102.

ben: I'll handle deployment safety controls: add canary gating that monitors chunk-gap p90 and aborts rollout if it exceeds threshold, plus a temporary rollout rollback script. ETA: Thu EOD. Ticket RW-6103.

ops-bot: Tickets created: RW-6101 (omar), RW-6102 (lucy), RW-6103 (ben). Links: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-6101 https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-6102 https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-6103

nina: Fast remediations we can flip this week: increase heartbeat from 18s->10s for impacted fleets, enable ephemeral KV replication for hot sessions, and set a temporary traffic cap to affected nodes. Which owner can do each toggle?

omar: I can add the traffic cap toggle and admission control config. Will coordinate with infra. ETA: Tue morning. RW-6104.

lucy: I'll validate telemetry when heartbeat changes are applied and estimate alert noise. Need an observability quota bump request. Can someone file that?

ben: I'll open RW-6105 for the quota request and tag infra. ETA: today.

lucy: Draft event schema I'll push to RW-6102 PR: {"event":"chunk_gap","session_id":"s","gap_ms":"i","node":"n","deployment":"d"} (will expand).

omar: SDK sample (quick draft): ```js
const backoff = (attempt) => Math.min(1000 * 2 ** attempt, 8000) * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4);
// maxRetries = 3
```

ben: Good. For rollout gate I'll add a short-runbook: check chunk-gap p90 in canary for 10m, abort if > 4s or spike > 0.2% of sessions. I'll include pager list.

nina: Ownership checklist for retro doc: - Reconnect playbook & SDK defaults: omar  RW-6101  Wed noon - Chunk-gap detector & dashboard: lucy  RW-6102  Tue AM - Canary rollout gate + rollback: ben  RW-6103  Thu EOD - Traffic cap toggle: omar  RW-6104  Tue AM - Obs quota request: ben  RW-6105  today

lucy: :white_check_mark: will pair with infra once RW-6105 is approved to validate ingestion.

omar: :white_check_mark: will draft SDK PR and ping devex for review.

ben: :white_check_mark: opened RW-6105 and cc'ed infra. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-6105

ops-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 3187654321 in 72 hours.

nina: Thanks all. If anything slips, drop a short update here so I can update the retro summary and leadership note.
